title: What are AI evals? · study notes
copy:
Exact title: "What are AI evals?". Exact subtitle: "Test the task. Inspect the failures.". Body copy (verbatim):
Evals are structured tests of an AI system.
Choose realistic cases and clear success criteria.
Run the system, score outputs, inspect failures.
Repeat after changes.
Small sticky note copy: "One good answer is not enough evidence.".
Diagram: A four-node process map Cases → Run → Score → Review. Original small ink illustrations of a test-card stack, simple robot, checklist and magnifying glass. A small loop arrow from Review back to Cases, clearly separate from main arrow path.
invocation: Use $cad-illustrated-study-notes to explain what are ai evals? for a beginner. Include an accurate diagram and one short tip. Use White faint graph paper, navy ink with lime and lilac accents, compact handwritten headline, generous whitespace.
